__inputs.name: DS_VM
__inputs.label: VictoriaMetrics (Prometheus)
__inputs.description: Select the Prometheus-compatible datasource for your authorized VictoriaMetrics query endpoint.

title: MeshCore · fleet, radios and bots
description: Native ESP32 telemetry and Python companion-bot metrics. Independent filters and explicit gaps; no synthetic health or RF delivery claims.

links.title: Remote repeater batteries and RF status

options.content:
**Two independent feeds:** ESP32 native publishing uses **device / role**; the Python companion bot uses **mesh / site (bot) / polled node / probe route**. Site must identify one bot. Filters do not join these feeds.

Report ages search the **History** window; no sample means absent or outside that window, not healthy. Age colors assume a 60-second publisher; adjust for your interval. Ordinary graphs use the selected time range and do not fill gaps. Instant readiness is not a live RF delivery check.

**Pine has no direct IP metrics.** A bot can report Pine's returned repeater status only when configured to poll it. Host Lua/Wasm roles have no native VictoriaMetrics exporter here. VM fields are the last Lua operation, not Wasm metrics, per-plugin metrics or task CPU time. See the adjacent dashboard README for coverage.

panels.title: Native device · age of last report
panels.description: Exact VictoriaMetrics sample age, including stale devices within History. Receipt time is not RF last-heard time.

panels.title: Companion bot · age of last collection sample
panels.description: Original collector timestamps are retained across writer retries. Age can grow even when delivery resumes.

panels.title: Native device · last reported uptime
panels.description: Last reported value, not an extrapolation to current uptime. Read report age alongside this value.

panels.title: Native role · readiness / identity
panels.description: Fixed native role slots. bot is the external KISS endpoint; command-bot is the on-device Lua service. Zero means the sampled role is not ready or has no identity.

panels.title: Internal heap · free / low-water / largest block
panels.description: Largest block indicates contiguous allocation headroom. The minimum is a reboot-lifetime low-water gauge.

panels.title: DMA-capable heap · free / low-water / largest block
panels.description: DMA-capable memory overlaps internal heap; do not add these pools.

panels.title: PSRAM · free / low-water / largest / total
panels.description: Absent on boards without detected PSRAM.

panels.title: WiFi RSSI
panels.description: RSSI is emitted only while connected. A retained RSSI does not prove current connectivity; check report age.

panels.title: MCU temperature
panels.description: Die temperature, not ambient. Unsupported or nonfinite sensor values are absent.

panels.title: Battery voltage
panels.description: Only emitted with a real battery measurement; the pinned XIAO S3 WIO omits it. No battery percentage is inferred.

panels.title: WiFi · sampled connection
panels.description: Sampled connection flag; this cannot report an outage while the publisher itself is disconnected. Use report age.

panels.title: Native shared radio · physical RF and scheduler
Physical RF packets / transmit outcomes
panels.description: RX excludes local reflection. Accepted is admission; succeeded is local TX completion, not peer acknowledgement. Unknown is an uncertain local outcome.

panels.title: RF errors / admission rejection
panels.description: Reboot-reset counters; driver RX errors also wrap at 32 bits.

panels.title: RF airtime · observed TX / estimated RX
panels.description: Seconds per second, shown as percent. TX is physical observed duration; RX is an estimate. Neither is peer delivery.

panels.title: Shared scheduler · queue / transmitting / carrier wait / fault
panels.description: Queue is packet count; the other gauges are state flags. A fault of 1 needs inspection.

panels.title: Shared scheduler · airtime credit
panels.description: Current scheduler credit, not cumulative airtime.

panels.title: Source outcomes
panels.description: Role counters are subsets of physical RF totals. Do not add them to physical totals. They reset on source reattachment.

panels.title: Source queue / transmitting
panels.description: Only attached sources emit these gauges. Unattributed host-client traffic still appears in physical totals.

panels.title: Source generation
panels.description: Generation changes identify source reattachment and counter resets; this is a gauge, not a label or a counter.

panels.title: Source RF airtime
panels.description: Observed RF seconds/second attributable to the source. Subsets of the shared radio, not additional airtime.

panels.title: Source airtime credit
panels.description: Current source credit; attached sources only.

panels.title: On-device Lua · jobs, outcomes and last operation
Native job slots occupied
panels.description: Occupied I/O job slots include completions awaiting dispatch. This is not a coroutine count or plugin invocation count.

panels.title: Lua failures / busy / admission limits
panels.description: Service-wide counters, not per-plugin series.

panels.title: Lua event flow / replies
panels.description: Event completion is not a peer acknowledgement; replies are service counters.

panels.title: Last Lua VM phase · fraction of default budget
panels.description: Latest completed operation only, not phase maxima. Default limits: load 330ms, init 50ms, active invoke 20ms. Cached invokes have zero load/init; suspended I/O and RF wait are excluded.

panels.title: Last Lua VM · peak allocation / free heap / stack low-water
panels.description: Sample of the latest completed source load or invocation; stack is worker-task low-water free space, not every task's stack. Fields appear only after a VM sample.

panels.title: Last Lua VM · wall time / phases
panels.description: Gauges, not rates. Includes the latest operation's accounted phases, not running-job CPU usage.

panels.title: Last Lua VM · instructions
panels.description: Instruction count of the last completed VM operation; a gauge, not cumulative invocations.

panels.title: Companion bot · connection, collection and VictoriaMetrics delivery
Bot connection state
panels.description: site is the bot selector because this emitter has no bot label. Give each bot a unique mesh/site tag pair.

panels.title: Bot uptime
panels.description: Process uptime, not companion-radio uptime.

panels.title: Bot command / capture queues
panels.description: Capture queue fields are omitted when no capture writer exists.

panels.title: Collector / exporter failures and discarded data
panels.description: Counters reset on bot restart. A disconnected receiver cannot receive failure reports until connectivity returns.

panels.title: Writer backlog
panels.description: Includes in-flight body. Queue is memory-only and is not durable across crashes.

panels.title: Collector / writer success age and oldest queued batch
panels.description: Zero success timestamps are suppressed. Collection can succeed while an individual source fails. These gauges can themselves go stale; use fleet report age.

panels.title: Passive source availability
panels.description: Successful empty collection is 1; unreadable source is 0. This does not initiate device queries.

panels.title: Collector / writer request duration
panels.description: Last-operation duration gauges. Native ESP32 publisher HTTP timing is not exported.

panels.title: Companion bot · shared RF work scheduler
RF work · queue depth / running
panels.description: Bot-owned operator/status/probe jobs, not packets. Running exchanges are never pre-empted.

panels.title: RF work · oldest wait / active job duration
panels.description: Current gauges. Long operator jobs can delay optional polls and probes.

panels.title: RF work · outcomes
panels.description: One outcome per job or batch, not packet deliveries. Cancelled includes queue timeouts.

panels.title: Observer · received traffic, commands and retained state
Observed RF packet rate
panels.description: Trailing-window count divided by window seconds. Despite the name _total, this is a window gauge: do not use rate(). Physical captured packets only.

panels.title: RF packet mix · trailing window
panels.description: Window gauges. Repeated hashes are extra observations, not packet loss.

panels.title: Receiver SNR · window mean / min / max
panels.description: Gated by sample count so empty windows do not show a retained old signal mean.

panels.title: Receiver RSSI · window mean / min / max
panels.description: Local receiver measurements, including the final relay on multihop traffic.

panels.title: Commands · requests / replies / without reply
panels.description: Trailing-window gauges for registered commands (unknown names become other). Recorded replies are not RF acknowledgements.

panels.title: Database / WAL storage
panels.description: Python bot file sizes only. No on-device KV, file, timer or reminder storage usage is exported.

panels.title: Heard nodes · freshness windows
panels.description: Population of contacts heard during each labelled window; gauges, not rates. Includes nodes beyond individual-series caps.

panels.title: Retained graph / path / neighbour populations
panels.description: Stored summaries, not rateable counters. Exported edges are capped. Prefix-only endpoints are not resolved identities.

panels.title: Polled relay / companion · returned status and configured probes
Node status · age of last successful sample
panels.description: Age of returned status, not last advert. Polling must already be configured in the bot. Importing this dashboard sends no RF requests.

panels.title: Node poll result / probe result
panels.description: Last sampled exchange outcome, not a cumulative counter or packet delivery ratio. Probe route is independent of node filter.

panels.title: Node reported uptime
panels.description: Device uptime from status/local stats. This can describe Pine only if the bot actually polls Pine.

panels.title: Node battery voltage
panels.description: Returned battery millivolts converted to volts. Missing readings are not filled.

panels.title: Node RF packet / duplicate / error counters
panels.description: These unsuffixed fields are monotonic device counters, reset on reboot. Unsupported firmware fields are absent.

panels.title: Node TX / RX airtime
panels.description: Cumulative seconds converted to seconds/second. Status semantics are separate from native shared-radio attribution.

panels.title: Node TX queue
panels.description: Gauge from the last returned status/local radio stats. Missing node status does not become zero.

panels.title: Configured probe · directed link SNR
panels.description: Each hop reports reception of the previous hop. A later failed probe can leave an older signal sample; inspect probe outcome and sample time.
